text:
I'm sorry, that's frustrating, especially when you were expecting a different plant.

The policy information I have doesn't cover wrong items being delivered, so I can't tell you what the remedy or timeframe would be (replacement, refund or return). The Plant Care Guarantee only covers plants that die or decline, so it doesn't apply here. I can escalate this to a Support Lead to sort out. To do that, please send me:

- Your order number (it looks like `LF-` followed by six digits)
- A photo of the plant you received, and ideally of its label or care card

One safety note: pothos is **not pet-safe**, while peperomia is. If you have pets, keep the pothos out of their reach until this is resolved. If a pet or person may have eaten any of it, contact a doctor, vet or poison control first.

Would you like me to escalate this now?
